tcgsniper.text: How to Set Up TCGPlayer Price Alerts - Get Notified When Prices Drop — TCGSniper Skip to content How It Works Pricing FAQ Discord Log In Start Free How It Works Pricing FAQ Discord Log In Start Free Home TCGPlayer Price Alerts How to get price drop alerts for any TCGPlayer listing. TCGPlayer doesn't notify you when prices drop. tcgSniper does. Set a target price on any card, sealed product, or accessory, and get alerted by email, text, or Discord the moment it hits your number. Create Your First Alert Free forever · No credit card + Card Kingdom & more The problem TCGPlayer has no price alerts. So we built them. You've been there. You find a card on TCGPlayer, the price is a little too high, and you tell yourself you'll check back later. But later becomes next week, and by then the price already dipped and bounced back up. That window is gone. How it works Set up a TCGPlayer alert in 30 seconds. 1 Paste a TCGPlayer URL Copy any product URL from TCGPlayer.com and paste it into tcgSniper. Or search by card name - we'll find it across marketplaces. 2 Pick your variants Choose condition, foil treatment, and language. Add as many variants as you want - they're free and unlimited. Only products count toward your alert limit. 3 Set your price & wait Enter your target price. Choose whether to include shipping. We'll monitor the listing and notify you the moment it drops to your number. Paste any TCGPlayer URL. We handle the rest. Start Tracking TCGPlayer Prices 15 free alerts · No credit card Why you need price alerts for TCGPlayer TCGPlayer is the largest marketplace for trading card games. Millions of listings across Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, Star Wars: Unlimited, and dozens more. Prices shift constantly as sellers undercut each other, new inventory hits the market, and demand fluctuates with tournament results and set releases. The problem? TCGPlayer doesn't offer any way to get notified when a card drops to the price you want. You're left refreshing the page manually, hoping to catch the dip. That's where tcgSniper comes in. What makes tcgSniper different Cross-marketplace search Search once and we'll find the card on TCGPlayer, Card Kingdom, and more. One alert covers every marketplace. Unlimited free variants Track Near Mint, Lightly Played, foil, non-foil, any language. Variants don't count toward your alert limit. Smart notifications Intelligent snoozing means no spam. We only re-notify when the price changes again and still meets your target. Email, SMS & Discord Get alerts where you already are. Email for everyone, SMS and Discord DMs on Plus. New TCGplayer Direct filtering Only get alerted for Direct-eligible listings. Authenticated cards, consolidated shipping, and free shipping over $50. Works for everything on TCGPlayer If it has a TCGPlayer listing, you can set an alert on it. Singles, sealed product, booster boxes, bundles, accessories - anything. tcgSniper supports every game on TCGPlayer: Magic: The Gathering Pokémon Yu-Gi-Oh! Lorcana Star Wars: Unlimited One Piece Dragon Ball Super Vanguard + everything else Not just TCGPlayer tcgSniper monitors prices across multiple marketplaces. When you create an alert, we check TCGPlayer, Card Kingdom, and more - all from a single alert. You don't need to set up separate alerts per site. If the card you want drops to your price on any supported marketplace, you'll know. + more coming Pricing Start free. Upgrade when you want. No hidden fees. No surprise charges. No credit card to start. Base Everything you need to start Free forever 15 product alerts Unlimited variants per alert Email notifications Cross-marketplace search Frequent price checks Intelligent snoozing Precision Filters (shipping & TCGplayer Direct) Get Started 1 month free Plus For serious collectors & flippers $5 /mo Less than a booster pack Unlimited* product alerts Unlimited variants per alert Email + SMS + Discord Priority price checks Protected by our refund policy Start Free Trial *Soft cap of 100, expandable on request. Just ask. FAQ TCGPlayer price alert questions Does TCGPlayer have built-in price alerts? No. TCGPlayer does not offer price drop alerts or notifications. You can add items to a cart or wishlist, but there's no way to get notified when a listing drops to a specific price. tcgSniper fills that gap - paste any TCGPlayer URL and set your target price. How do I set up a price alert for a TCGPlayer listing? Sign up at tcgSniper.com (free, no credit card), paste the TCGPlayer product URL, choose the condition and variants you want to track, and set your desired price. That's it. We'll monitor the listing and notify you when the price drops to your target. Can I include shipping in my target price? Yes. When setting up an alert, you can toggle whether to include shipping in the price comparison. This way you're comparing the true total cost, not just the sticker price. Can I filter for TCGplayer Direct listings only? Yes! tcgSniper now supports TCGplayer Direct filtering as a store-specific setting. When you enable it on a TCGplayer alert, you'll only be notified for Direct-eligible listings. That means authenticated cards, consolidated shipping, and free shipping on US orders over $50. This setting is available on every plan, free and Plus. Is tcgSniper free? Yes. The Base plan is free forever with no credit card required. You get 15 product alerts with unlimited variants and email notifications. Plus ($5/month, first month free) adds unlimited alerts, SMS, Discord, and priority price checks. Does it work for sealed product on TCGPlayer? Absolutely. Booster boxes, ETBs, bundles, starter decks, accessories - if it has a TCGPlayer listing, you can track it. Singles are the most common use case, but sealed product alerts are especially popular with Pokémon and MTG collectors. Will I get spammed with alerts? No. tcgSniper uses intelligent snoozing. After notifying you about a price drop, we won't re-notify for the same alert unless the price changes again and still meets your target. Every notification is worth your attention. Stop refreshing TCGPlayer. Let us watch for you. Your first alert takes 30 seconds. Free forever. No credit card. Create Your First Alert Price drop alerts across TCG marketplaces.
